class.name: HaxeLanguage
class.description: The language registered with the script server for `.hx` files. It creates Haxe scripts, provides the script templates the editor's [b]Create New → Script[/b] dialog offers, and answers the editor's language queries. Code completion, lookup and validation are parser-based and run inside the engine, without an external language server; the Haxe compiler remains the authority on whether the code compiles. There is normally no reason to reference this class directly: scripts are created from the editor or with [method ResourceLoader.load].
